meta.source: Logo (PNG, 172x64) and the Elite Academy website brief, September 2026

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Logo orange, sampled from the mark's figure. Fills only on light (2.5:1 on white, never text): primary buttons, active tab bars, the SAQR button. On dark it also works as text (7.4:1 on surface).

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Logo blue, sampled from the mark's swooshes. Secondary buttons, icons, Promenade branch marker, large headings accents. Light value is 4.9:1 on white; for small text on tinted grounds use blue-text.

tokens.name: brand-gray
tokens.usage: Logo grey, sampled from the ELITE ACADEMY wordmark. Used as ink-muted in light.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: a clean, warm mat. Never pure grey.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, header, chat panel. The only ground the logo sits on directly (light).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Alternate sections, schedule grid, photo placeholders, the playbook-illustration band.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: Footer, CTA strip, image scrims, SAQR panel header. A night-blue deepened from brand-blue; carries on-deep text.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text on surface-deep (14:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken (16:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, meta lines on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (5.3:1+ light, 7.5:1+ dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (decorative only).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders, unselected chips (3.5:1 light, 3.6:1 dark on raised).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary CTA fill: Book a trial, Add to cart, Send code. One per view region.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary CTA hover / pressed.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action and action-hover (6.9:1 / 5.5:1). Never white on orange.

tokens.name: orange-soft
tokens.usage: Promo banner ground, Bedaya tint, highlighted price row.

tokens.name: orange-text
tokens.usage: Orange as text: eyebrows, Bedaya label, promo end date. 4.9:1+ on orange-soft and surfaces.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Promenade tint, info notes, selected filter chip ground, SAQR bot bubble.

tokens.name: blue-text
tokens.usage: Links and blue text on any surface and blue-soft (6.2:1+).

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text on brand-blue fills (4.9:1 light, 6.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element (4.6:1+ on all surfaces).

tokens.name: branch-promenade
tokens.usage: Elite Promenade (Hawalli) marker: branch dot, card top rule, map pin, schedule filter.

tokens.name: branch-promenade-soft
tokens.usage: Promenade tinted grounds.

tokens.name: branch-bedaya
tokens.usage: Elite Bedaya (Sabah Al Salem) marker. Equal rank to Promenade: same size, same weight, never a 'secondary' colour.

tokens.name: branch-bedaya-soft
tokens.usage: Bedaya tinted grounds.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed, in stock, booking sent. Always with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success note ground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors, sold out, payment failed. Always with an icon and a word (6.5:1).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error note ground.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Membership expiring, few spots left (5.9:1).

tokens.name: belt-white
tokens.usage: White belt. Always drawn with a line-strong outline.

tokens.name: belt-yellow
tokens.usage: Yellow belt.

tokens.name: belt-orange
tokens.usage: Orange belt (Kyokushin / Taekwondo paths; confirm with instructors).

tokens.name: belt-red
tokens.usage: Red belt (Taekwondo path; confirm with instructors).

tokens.name: belt-purple
tokens.usage: Purple belt (Kajukenbo).

tokens.name: belt-blue
tokens.usage: Blue belt. Deliberately deeper than brand-blue so it reads as a belt, not a link.

tokens.name: belt-green
tokens.usage: Green belt.

tokens.name: belt-brown
tokens.usage: Brown belt.

tokens.name: belt-black
tokens.usage: Black belt. In dark theme drawn with a line-strong outline.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay under hero text and the photo viewer.

families.display: "Readex Pro Latin", "Readex Pro Arabic", "Readex Pro", system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: "Plex Latin", "Plex Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page. Arabic: drop letterSpacing to 0.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Label above a title, uppercase in English. Arabic: no uppercase, letterSpacing 0, 14px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ages 5–12 train both striking and grappling, alternating through the week.
styles.usage: Body copy. Minimum body size on phones; line-height suits Arabic too.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Open daily except Thursday and Friday.
styles.usage: Card meta, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, legal lines. Never for anything a parent must act on.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices. Tabular figures, always 3 decimals, KD after the number (English) / د.ك after (Arabic).

spacing.note: 4px base. Mobile page gutter space-4, desktop space-8 inside a 1200px container.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap in chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label to input, meta lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip padding, gap in button groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter, card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gap on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, grid gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; title to content in a block.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a block.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Block padding top/bottom on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Block padding on tablets.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Block padding top/bottom on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, belt swatches, timetable cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, photos inside cards, accordions.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero media, chat panel, bottom sheets, big photo tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: SAQR button, language switch, filter chips.

shadow.note: Warm and low. Cards sit on borders first; shadows are for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards, sticky header.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Card hover, dropdowns, sticky mobile CTA bar.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: SAQR panel, modals, size guide sheet, floating chat button.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Site header on phones (72px desktop).

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: belt-bar
tokens.usage: Thickness of the belt stripe used as section marker and progress bar.
